name: Arceus
description: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a primeval power. This may also raise the user's offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Recover
moves.description: The user regenerates its cells to restore its own HP.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power.

moves.name: Judgment
moves.description: The user releases countless shots of light at the target. This move's type varies depending on the kind of Plate the user last interacted with.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam.
